decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Before any works commence on site, and notwithstanding requirements of Building Regulations which may be called for, details of structural and constructions specifications to demonstrate that the extension can be built as hereby approved shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and the extension shall then only be built in accordance with the scheme so approved.
Condition : 4 - Where glass is to be used in the proposed development it must be self-cleaning glass or similar
description: Erection of a roof extension comprising of a transparent butt glazed extension between the two existing pitched roof ridges with a roof window to the front and two to the rear of the house.
